profile.name: Yoctopuce SPI通信接口模块
profile.description: 用于实验系统中连接和控制 SPI 外设的硬件接口模块，可配置串行协议、SPI 模式、位序、片选线极性与电平，并发送、接收和查询文本或二进制数据。
profile.description_en: A hardware SPI interface module for connecting and controlling SPI peripherals in laboratory setups. It can configure the serial protocol, SPI mode, bit order, chip-select polarity, and line voltage, and can send, receive, and query text or binary data.

registry.description: The YSpiPort class allows you to fully drive a Yoctopuce SPI port
